name: Utagoe 2 ~Dance Mix~
source:
Main character is a genius guitarist and producer. His task now is to train a four girl unit "BLMAX" and win the Grand Prix a competition held in three months time. As of now they don't sell at all, but it's a private request from his colleague Risa, and hero's indebted to her too much to refuse. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位天才吉他手和制作人。他现在的任务是培养四人女子组合“BLMAX”，并赢得三个月后举行的大奖赛。到目前为止，它们根本没有卖，但这是他的同事丽莎的私人请求，英雄对她的感激之情太多，无法拒绝。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
